Question 5

The length of a curve y=f(x) is given by ∫011+916e6xdx. Which of the following could be an equation for this curve?

a
 y=14e3x+4
b
 y=4e3x+4
c
 y=34ex+4
d
 y=12e3x+4
e
 y=14ex+4
